audience: consultants and teams that take bookings through SimplyMeet.me

useCases.title: Check open slots for a meeting type
useCases.text: List the event types. Then read the open slots of one type between two dates, in your time zone.

useCases.title: Review the bookings for next week
useCases.text: List the booked events. Open one to see its time, invitee and answers.

useCases.title: Cancel a booking
useCases.text: Read the event first. Then cancel it with a reason. Cancel the later events of a recurring booking if needed.
